plan.goal: Exhaustively explore the 6-step quote wizard, validate the claims submission form, and check FAQ interactions across desktop and mobile.
plan.summary: The exploration will start on the landing page to verify navigation, then dedicate the majority of effort to deeply exercising the 6-step quote wizard (especially the custom breed combobox and multi-select conditions). Afterward, it will validate the claims form and FAQ accordions. A final mobile pass will ensure the complex wizard UI and small tap targets remain usable on smaller screens.
assumptions: The 6-step quote wizard is contained within a single HTML file (quote.html) using JavaScript to manage state and DOM updates.
The breed combobox supports keyboard navigation (up/down/enter/esc) as described in the summary.
Form submissions (Claims) might be mocked but should have validation or success states.
risk_hotspots: quote.html: ARIA combobox for breed selection (keyboard navigation and dynamic filtering)
quote.html: State retention when navigating backward through the wizard steps
quote.html: Collapsible side-by-side comparison table on the Tier selection step
Header navigation: Multiple 'small_tap_target' warnings indicate potential mobile usability issues

phases.title: Landing & Static Content
phases.objective: Verify homepage layout, header navigation, and FAQ accordion functionality.
key_checks: Open and close multiple <details> accordions on the FAQ page
exit_criteria: Successfully navigated to FAQ and toggled at least two questions.

phases.title: Quote Wizard - Steps 1-3
phases.objective: Exercise the initial data gathering steps of the quote flow.
key_checks: Interact with the breed combobox (type to filter, use arrow keys to select)
Use the age stepper and toggle between years/months
exit_criteria: Successfully progressed past the age step with valid data.

phases.title: Quote Wizard - Steps 4-6
phases.objective: Complete the quote flow, testing multi-select, tier cards, and summary.
key_checks: Select multiple pre-existing conditions and test the 'None' toggle
Select different coverage tiers and observe live quote updates
Use the dot indicator or 'Back' button to return to a previous step and verify state retention
Reach the final quote summary screen
exit_criteria: Final quote summary screen is reached and backward navigation was proven to retain state.

phases.title: Claims Form
phases.objective: Validate the inputs and submission of the file a claim form.
key_checks: Fill out text, date, and number inputs
Interact with the file upload input
Submit the form and observe success or error states

phases.title: Mobile Responsive Verification
phases.objective: Ensure complex components and small tap targets are usable on mobile.
key_checks: Complete a fast-path quote flow on the mobile viewport, focusing on the breed combobox and tier selection layout
exit_criteria: Completed one full quote flow in mobile mode.

coverage_targets.features: Exercise all 6 steps of the quote wizard, including edge cases like keyboard nav in combobox and 'None' toggle in conditions.
coverage_targets.mobile: Re-run the complete quote flow and test header navigation on mobile viewport.

notes: Pay special attention to the layout of the 6-step dot indicator and floating Back/Continue bar on mobile.
